summary: PO 2018 section 7: all modules are compulsory except two either/or choices: module 6.2 'Option Forschung' (12 ECTS) or 'Option Anwendung & Kritik' (9 ECTS), and module 7.2 'Vertiefung der Grundlagen' (12 ECTS) or 'Theorie-Praxis-Projektstudium' (15 ECTS). The key competencies requirement is 6 ECTS (6.2a + 7.2b), 9 ECTS (one of them) or 12 ECTS (6.2b + 7.2a).
